The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.63 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three MoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra.
